meta_title: Concept North East | Trusted Plumber Newcastle
meta_description: Concept North East are Newcastle's reliable plumbers. Fast response, quality workmanship, and honest pricing. Call today for a free quote across the North East.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Qualified Plumbers — Serving Newcastle & the North East
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, or full bathroom fits — we're on hand quickly so you're never left waiting.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing Services Across Newcastle & the North East
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to planned bathroom renovations, Concept North East delivers skilled plumbing solutions for homes and businesses across the region.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, sudden leaks, or a loss of water pressure — we respond fast to protect your home from costly water damage. Available for urgent call-outs across Newcastle and surrounding areas.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: We install, service, and repair all major boiler brands, keeping your heating and hot water running reliably. Whether it's a fault code or a full replacement, we'll have it sorted efficiently.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: From en-suite makeovers to complete bathroom refits, we handle all plumbing aspects to a high finish. We work tidily, to your timeline, and leave the space ready to enjoy.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: New central heating systems, radiator installations, and power flushing to restore heat output throughout your property. We'll ensure every room reaches the right temperature efficiently.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left untreated. We locate and repair leaks swiftly, minimising disruption and protecting your property long term.

services.title: General Plumbing & Maintenance
services.desc: Dripping taps, blocked drains, toilet cistern faults, and pipework upgrades — no job is too small. Regular maintenance keeps your plumbing system running smoothly and helps avoid expensive future repairs.

about_pullquote: We take pride in doing the job right, every single time.
about_para_1: Concept North East was founded by experienced local tradespeople with a passion for delivering honest, high-quality plumbing across Newcastle and the wider North East. Built on a reputation for reliability and transparent pricing, we've grown steadily through word-of-mouth recommendations from satisfied customers throughout the region.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our straightforward approach — no inflated quotes, no unnecessary work, and no hidden charges. Our customers return to us time and again because they trust us to treat their homes with respect and to get the job done properly the first time.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Concept North East

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. Called Concept North East about a leak under my kitchen sink and they were with me the same afternoon. Fixed quickly, no mess left behind, and the price was very fair. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler fitted and couldn't be happier. The lads were professional, punctual, and explained everything clearly. The whole job was done in a day with minimal disruption. Highly recommend to anyone in the Newcastle area.
reviews.author: David R.

reviews.text: Really honest and reliable company. They came out to quote for a full bathroom refit, gave a competitive price, and the finished result looks fantastic. Turned up when they said they would and kept me updated throughout. Top quality work.
reviews.author: Michelle B.
